name: ScrollArea
description: Scrolls overflowing content with a slim scrollbar and optional edge fades.

scrollbarVisibility.description: When the thin scrollbar shows: auto while scrolling, on hover and while focus is inside; always all the time

showFades.description: Show gradient fade indicators at scroll edges

aria-label.description: Names the viewport as a region, read when it takes the keyboard

when: Content that overflows a fixed-size container
Tab bars or chip rows that may run past the edge
Scrollable panels, sidebars, and menu content
whenNot: Whole-page scrolling (use the native body scroll)
guidelines: orientation constrains which axis can scroll
showFades hints at hidden content when nothing else does
scrollbarVisibility="auto" shows the thumb only while the area is used, without shifting layout
The container needs a fixed height or the area cannot scroll
accessibility: Preserves native scroll behavior and keyboard support across both axes
A viewport that scrolls and holds nothing focusable takes the keyboard; the area rings outside its edge, clear of the fades
aria-label or aria-labelledby names the viewport as a region
The scrollbar shows while focus is inside

examples.name: Vertical
examples.description: Scrolls down with a thin, always-visible thumb.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ScrollArea';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<Box>
  <ScrollArea style={{ height: '200px' }}>
    <Box inset="compact">
      <Stack gap="sm">
        <Text>Row 1</Text>
        <Text>Row 2</Text>
        <Text>Row 3</Text>
        <Text>Row 4</Text>
        <Text>Row 5</Text>
        <Text>Row 6</Text>
        <Text>Row 7</Text>
        <Text>Row 8</Text>
        <Text>Row 9</Text>
        <Text>Row 10</Text>
        <Text>Row 11</Text>
        <Text>Row 12</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </ScrollArea>
</Box>

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.description: Keeps an overflowing row of chips on one line.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Chip } from '@/components/Chip';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ScrollArea';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Box>
  <ScrollArea orientation="horizontal">
    <Stack direction="row" gap="sm">
      <Chip>React</Chip>
      <Chip>TypeScript</Chip>
      <Chip>Accessibility</Chip>
      <Chip>Docs</Chip>
      <Chip>Playground</Chip>
      <Chip>CLI</Chip>
      <Chip>Tokens</Chip>
      <Chip>Workspace</Chip>
      <Chip>Patterns</Chip>
      <Chip>Registry</Chip>
    </Stack>
  </ScrollArea>
</Box>

examples.name: Always Scrollbar
examples.description: The thumb stays visible for content that is always scrolled.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ScrollArea';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<Box>
  <ScrollArea scrollbarVisibility="always" style={{ height: '200px' }}>
    <Box inset="compact">
      <Stack gap="sm">
        <Text>Row 1</Text>
        <Text>Row 2</Text>
        <Text>Row 3</Text>
        <Text>Row 4</Text>
        <Text>Row 5</Text>
        <Text>Row 6</Text>
        <Text>Row 7</Text>
        <Text>Row 8</Text>
        <Text>Row 9</Text>
        <Text>Row 10</Text>
        <Text>Row 11</Text>
        <Text>Row 12</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </ScrollArea>
</Box>
